title: Machine Learning Engineer Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to deepen your ML expertise, build production‑grade projects, and prepare for senior roles. Focuses on best practices, scalability, and professional habits.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Refresh core math and Python fundamentals for reliable ML work.

milestones.title: Python for ML
milestones.outcome: Write clean, efficient Python scripts for data processing and modeling.

tasks.title: Review Python data structures
tasks.description: Read the official Python docs on lists, dicts, sets and practice creating each with sample data.

tasks.title: Implement a CSV loader
tasks.description: Write a function that reads a CSV file into a list of dictionaries without using pandas.

tasks.title: Practice list comprehensions
tasks.description: Solve 5 small problems from freeCodeCamp's Python section using list comprehensions.

tasks.title: Reflect on code style
tasks.description: Compare your code to PEP 8 guidelines and note three improvements.

milestones.title: Linear Algebra & Probability
milestones.outcome: Apply vector, matrix, and probability concepts to ML algorithms.

tasks.title: Watch Khan Academy linear algebra videos
tasks.description: Watch the 3‑video series on vectors, matrices, and eigenvalues (≈45 min total).

tasks.title: Derive gradient of a quadratic loss
tasks.description: Write out the gradient step‑by‑step on paper and verify with a small numeric example.

tasks.title: Simulate a Bernoulli trial
tasks.description: Use Python's random module to run 1,000 trials and compute empirical probability.

tasks.title: Connect with a math forum
tasks.description: Post a question about eigenvalue intuition on StackExchange and read two answers.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Master essential ML libraries, evaluation, and MLOps basics.

milestones.title: scikit‑learn Mastery
milestones.outcome: Build, tune, and evaluate classic models using scikit‑learn pipelines.

tasks.title: Read scikit-learn pipeline guide
tasks.description: Study the official scikit-learn documentation on Pipelines and FeatureUnion.

tasks.title: Create a preprocessing pipeline
tasks.description: Implement a pipeline that imputes missing values and scales numeric features for a sample dataset.

tasks.title: Tune hyperparameters with GridSearchCV
tasks.description: Run a grid search on a RandomForest model and record the best parameters.

tasks.title: Reflect on model bias
tasks.description: Write a short note on how preprocessing choices affect bias in your model.

milestones.title: Deep Learning with PyTorch
milestones.outcome: Design, train, and debug neural networks using PyTorch.

tasks.title: Watch PyTorch fundamentals tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the official PyTorch 60‑minute introductory video on tensors and autograd.

tasks.title: Implement a two‑layer MLP
tasks.description: Code a multilayer perceptron for the MNIST dataset without using high‑level APIs.

tasks.title: Debug a vanishing gradient case
tasks.description: Introduce a deep network, observe gradients, and apply ReLU to fix the issue.

tasks.title: Connect on PyTorch forums
tasks.description: Introduce yourself on the PyTorch Discuss forum and comment on a recent post.

milestones.title: Model Evaluation Techniques
milestones.outcome: Select and compute appropriate metrics for classification and regression tasks.

tasks.title: Read evaluation metrics chapter on MDN
tasks.description: Study MDN's guide to precision, recall, ROC‑AUC, and RMSE.

tasks.title: Calculate confusion matrix manually
tasks.description: Write Python code that computes TP, FP, FN, TN from raw predictions.

tasks.title: Practice cross‑validation
tasks.description: Implement k‑fold cross‑validation for a logistic regression model and log variance of scores.

tasks.title: Reflect on metric trade‑offs
tasks.description: Summarize when to prioritize precision vs. recall in a short paragraph.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase end‑to‑end ML pipelines.

milestones.title: Churn Prediction Model
milestones.outcome: Publish a complete churn prediction notebook with analysis and write‑up.

tasks.title: Gather a public churn dataset
tasks.description: Download the Telco Customer Churn dataset from Kaggle and store it locally.

tasks.title: Build data cleaning pipeline
tasks.description: Use scikit-learn transformers to handle missing values and encode categoricals.

tasks.title: Train and evaluate models
tasks.description: Compare Logistic Regression, XGBoost, and a simple neural net, recording metrics.

tasks.title: Write a project report
tasks.description: Draft a 2‑page markdown report describing methodology, results, and next steps.

tasks.title: Publish on GitHub
tasks.description: Create a repository, push code, and add a README with a link to the report.

milestones.title: Image Classifier API
milestones.outcome: Deploy a trained image classifier as a REST API reachable from any client.

tasks.title: Select a small image dataset
tasks.description: Download the CIFAR‑10 subset from the official site for quick iteration.

tasks.title: Train a CNN in PyTorch
tasks.description: Implement a convolutional network, train for 10 epochs, and achieve >70% accuracy.

tasks.title: Containerize with Docker
tasks.description: Write a Dockerfile that serves the model via FastAPI and test locally.

tasks.title: Deploy to a free cloud service
tasks.description: Push the Docker image to Render or Railway and obtain a public endpoint.

tasks.title: Document API usage
tasks.description: Create a Swagger/OpenAPI spec and a short usage guide in the repo.

milestones.title: Model Monitoring Dashboard
milestones.outcome: Set up a dashboard that tracks model drift and performance in real time.

tasks.title: Read MLOps monitoring guide
tasks.description: Study the free MLOps basics section on the Google Cloud AI blog.

tasks.title: Simulate prediction stream
tasks.description: Write a script that generates synthetic predictions and true labels every minute.

tasks.title: Create Grafana panels
tasks.description: Configure Grafana to display latency, accuracy, and drift metrics from the stream.

tasks.title: Set up alert thresholds
tasks.description: Define alerts for sudden drops in accuracy and test them with injected drift.

tasks.title: Share dashboard publicly
tasks.description: Publish a read‑only link and write a brief explanation for portfolio viewers.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance to production‑grade practices and prepare for job or client interviews.

milestones.title: MLOps Foundations
milestones.outcome: Implement CI/CD for model training and deployment using open‑source tools.

tasks.title: Watch CI/CD for ML tutorial
tasks.description: View the free Coursera Community tutorial on GitHub Actions for ML pipelines (≈45 min).

tasks.title: Create a GitHub Actions workflow
tasks.description: Automate data validation, model training, and artifact upload on push events.

tasks.title: Practice model versioning
tasks.description: Use DVC to track dataset and model versions in a sample project.

tasks.title: Reflect on reproducibility
tasks.description: Write three bullet points on how your workflow improves reproducibility.

tasks.title: Connect with MLOps community
tasks.description: Join the MLOps Community Slack and introduce yourself.

milestones.title: Advanced PyTorch & Scaling
milestones.outcome: Train large models efficiently with GPUs and distributed strategies.

tasks.title: Read PyTorch Distributed Data Parallel docs
tasks.description: Study the official guide on DDP and note key configuration steps.

tasks.title: Run a multi‑GPU training job
tasks.description: Modify the earlier CNN to use DDP on two GPUs (or simulated with CPU threads).

tasks.title: Profile memory usage
tasks.description: Use torch.profiler to identify bottlenecks and reduce peak memory.

tasks.title: Reflect on scaling trade‑offs
tasks.description: Summarize advantages and challenges of distributed training in a short note.

tasks.title: Connect on PyTorch Lightning forum
tasks.description: Ask a question about DDP best practices and read two replies.

milestones.title: Interview & Portfolio Polish
milestones.outcome: Confidently discuss projects, solve white‑board problems, and present a professional portfolio.

tasks.title: Review common ML interview questions
tasks.description: Read the freeCodeCamp article on top ML interview questions and note key concepts.

tasks.title: Practice a white‑board case study
tasks.description: Spend 45 minutes solving a churn prediction scenario on paper, focusing on feature engineering and evaluation.

tasks.title: Update portfolio README
tasks.description: Add concise project summaries, tech stack badges, and a contact link to each repo.

tasks.title: Record a project walkthrough video
tasks.description: Create a 5‑minute screen‑recorded demo of one project and upload to YouTube.

tasks.title: Seek feedback from peers
tasks.description: Share your portfolio with two experienced engineers and incorporate their suggestions.
